answer: Why do clone farms stay cheap? Because identity is free to mint. Layer3 quest completion history changes that arithmetic: quests finished across three seasons, so the harbor for each fake is paid in the real world. A farm's usual trick is reuse, and this kills reuse outright: quests finished across three seasons is fresh per account, and the ripple is that yesterday's proof is worthless today. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the nectar of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
